title: Anchor Windows staging parity to Git blobs and retain line-ending warnings
failure_signature: The exact staging pass succeeded while Git warned that twelve LF working-copy files may later be rewritten as CRLF.
trigger_preconditions: New text files staged for an exact content-seal commit
candidate_workaround: Use exact staged Git blobs as the commit and manifest domain, retain the warnings, and require the later named validation lane to preserve LF for its bounded replay.
recurrence_guard: Never equate a warning-bearing working copy with cross-checkout byte parity; inspect staged blobs and perform the authorized named replay.
rollback: Unstage without deleting files if staged-blob hashes fail; otherwise keep the normalized Git index and retain the warning as a negative.
protected_gates: No newline portability claim before named replay
scope_boundary: This method validates the staged Git-blob domain only and does not prove every checkout has identical working-tree bytes.
